funnel.title: Shopping journey
funnel.description: Distinct storefront sessions at each step, followed by placed orders.
funnel.emptyDescription: Visits and shopping actions will appear here as people use your storefront.
funnel.disclaimer: A visit starts when someone opens your shop and continues while they browse. If they leave for 30 minutes, their next return counts as a new visit. Orders are shown separately.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: A concise view of the selected sales period.
highlights.noSales: No placed orders in this period

opportunity.title: What to focus on
opportunity.description: A practical next step based on the activity currently available.

noData.title: Bring your first visitors
noData.description: Share your storefront link with customers. Once visits arrive, this section will highlight where the shopping journey can improve.

partialData.title: Recent activity is still syncing
partialData.description: Check back shortly for complete journey comparisons.

discovery.title: Help visitors find products
discovery.description: Many visits are not reaching a product page yet. Clearer categories, featured products, and a stronger first screen may help.

cart.title: Strengthen product pages
cart.description: Shoppers are viewing products but adding relatively few to cart. Review photos, descriptions, prices, and delivery information.

checkout.title: Make checkout feel easier
checkout.description: Some carts are not reaching checkout. Make delivery expectations and the next step clear before shoppers leave the cart.

conversion.title: Build confidence at checkout
conversion.description: Shoppers are starting checkout but fewer orders are being placed. Review payment availability, delivery details, and any checkout errors.

growing.title: Keep building on what works
growing.description: The available journey looks healthy. Continue promoting strong products and watch the trend as more activity arrives.
